body: Redirect-set cookies and DNR: observing a Set-Cookie then installing a session rule takes 1-23 ms (measured), but the 302 follow-up leaves immediately, so a cookie set on a redirect never reaches the next request. 0/10 on the three-hop probe; holding the follow-up in a debugger Fetch pause does not help because Chrome applies DNR header changes before the pause. Probe: spike/probe-redirect-cookie.mjs.
